lines.text: Boaz sits at the gate, gathers ten elders, and offers the nearer kinsman-redeemer Elimelech's land, and he says he will redeem it.
The nearer redeemer learns he must also acquire Ruth, so he says he cannot redeem it and gives Boaz his cloak.

wrong_details.true: removes his sandal and gives it to Boaz

lines.text: Boaz tells the witnesses he has acquired Ruth as his wife, and they wish her to be like Sarah and Rebekah.
Boaz takes Ruth as his wife, the LORD enables her to conceive, and Naomi becomes nurse to her son.
The neighbor women name the baby Obed, who becomes father of Jesse, the father of David.
